lead.headline: San Antonio nurse practitioner Kim Hinojosa prescribed $24.9M of specialty drugs to Medicare patients in 2022, most of any NP
lead.number: $24.9M of specialty Part D drugs in 2022 (hepatitis C, bowel disease and psoriasis drugs), then $1.37M in 2024; specialty peers run $12-19M.
lead.watch_out: The community-clinic (FQHC) tie is a current-address join, not proof she worked there in 2022.
